tips: Use the Industry view (key 2) to build factories and increase your income.
Fortifications (key 3) protect your provinces from enemy attacks.
Army view (key 5) lets you recruit, move, and command troops.
Navy view (key 6) controls ships, bombardments, and naval combat.
Research new technologies in the sidebar to unlock advanced units and buildings.
Claims view shows territorial disputes and lets you press or relinquish claims.
Economy panel shows your income, expenses, and research allocation.
Population view shows ethnic composition and minority alignment.
Relations view shows diplomatic standing with other countries.
Allocate more funds to research to unlock technologies faster.
Armies cost upkeep each turn - don't overextend your military.
Ships can bombard coastal provinces if you have researched artillery.
Ports allow ship construction and repair - build them in coastal provinces.
Minority alignment affects stability in multi-ethnic regions.
Pacification funding helps integrate conquered territories.
Move orders show percentage sliders - drag to adjust troop distribution.
Box select (hold bind key + drag) lets you select multiple ships at once in navy view mode.
Press Space or click the zoom-to key to fly to selected provinces or ships.
Alliances and guarantees affect who will join wars against you.
Keep an eye on your treasury - running a deficit will drain reserves.
Fortifications reduce damage from bombardments and assaults.
Artillery strikes can weaken enemy troops before an invasion.
Carrier-based aircraft can bombard provinces with napalm, carpet bombs, and more.
Navigate the research tree with the sidebar button - plan your tech path.
Population growth is affected by province development and policies.
Use the pause menu (ESC) to save your game or adjust settings.
The console window (debug mode) shows detailed game logs.
You can play as any country - select one from the country selection screen.
Spectator mode lets you observe the entire map without controlling any country.
Want to collect more money from province without upgrading level of industry in the province? Use specialisations!
